---
title: "Numbered unless unique"
theorems:
  numbered: unless-unique
---

# Numbering only when it helps

With `numbered: unless-unique`, a kind that appears once carries no number (the label
alone reads cleanly), while a kind that recurs is numbered so the references stay precise.

::: {.definition}
A sole definition needs no number.
:::

::: {.theorem}
The first of several theorems.
:::

::: {.theorem}
The second, so theorems are numbered.
:::
